name: Data Representation (Binary, Octal, Hexadecimal)
description: Understanding binary, octal, and hexadecimal number systems, conversion between number systems, and signed integer representation using Two's Complement.

name: Logic Gates & Boolean Algebra
description: Understanding basic logic gates (AND, OR, NOT, NAND, NOR, XOR, XNOR) and simplifying Boolean functions using Boolean Algebra laws and Karnaugh Maps (K-Map).

name: Combinational & Sequential Circuits
description: Studying combinational circuits (Adder, Subtractor, Multiplexer, Decoder) and sequential circuits (Latch, Flip-Flop, Register, Counter) and their applications.

name: CPU Architecture & Instruction Cycle
description: Understanding internal CPU components including ALU, Control Unit, and Register File, and how instructions are processed through the Fetch-Decode-Execute cycle.

name: Basic Assembly Language
description: Introduction to fundamental Assembly instructions (MOV, ADD, SUB, INC, DEC) and general-purpose CPU registers (e.g., EAX, EBX, ECX, EDX).

name: Assembly Branching & Loops
description: Understanding conditional and unconditional jump instructions (JMP, JE, JNE, JG, JL) and implementing loops and control flow in Assembly language.

name: Memory Hierarchy & Cache
description: Studying the computer memory hierarchy (Registers, Cache L1/L2/L3, RAM, ROM, Secondary Storage) and Cache mapping techniques (Direct, Associative, Set-Associative).

name: Input/Output & Interrupts
description: Understanding how external devices communicate with the CPU through Polling, Programmed I/O, hardware Interrupts (IRQ), and Direct Memory Access (DMA).
